name: Newport Beach Fire Cadet Program
what_you_do: Take part in a weekly program that teaches what it takes to be a Newport Beach firefighter. You do hands-on training and can ride along on real fire and medical calls.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 21. You must live in or go to school in Orange County and have finished 9th grade. You should want to learn about fire and emergency careers.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program page. Email the fire department to ask for an application.
how_to_apply: Email the fire department using the contact link on the program page. Ask for the program application. Ride-along forms for minors are posted on the page.
notes: This program used to be Explorer Post 309. You learn what school you need for fire careers. You also get tips on how to get ready.
